events.description: Multiple individuals engage in mutual physical combat, including punching, grappling, and shoving, with police and civilians intermingled in the scuffle.
A person is on the ground being struck and restrained by multiple individuals, including uniformed officers and others, while appearing unable to defend themselves.

Large group of riot police in full gear confronts a dense crowd in an enclosed space (likely a train station), escalating into physical clashes, pushing, and chaotic movement; presence of emergency responders indicates serious unrest.

A person in a dark hoodie is seen actively striking or pressing down on an individual lying on the ground, while others—including emergency responders and police—surround them; the prone individual appears unable to defend themselves.

Large group of civilians and riot police in green helmets and protective gear are engaged in intense close-quarters confrontation; pushing, shoving, and physical resistance occur repeatedly, with some individuals raising hands in surrender or protest while being contained or moved by officers.
A bald man in a black shirt is engaged in physical confrontation with riot police; officers are seen grabbing and restraining him while he resists, with visible arm contact and pushing.

Sustained tense standoff between a crowd of civilians and a line of riot police in full gear inside a station-like indoor space; multiple individuals raise hands (including peace signs), some film, and the situation escalates to physical contact by frame f12, indicating collective unrest and violent group clash.

A bald man in a black shirt engages in mutual physical combat with a riot police officer: the man pushes or strikes the officer while the officer reciprocates with a shove or strike; other officers and civilians are closely surrounding them.

Sustained violent group clash between a crowd of civilians and a line of riot police, involving pushing, shoving, and physical confrontation; the scene remains tense and dynamic throughout the interval with multiple individuals engaged in close contact with officers.

A bald man in black repeatedly gestures and pushes toward a line of riot police; officers respond with physical contact, including pushing back and apparent striking motions (e.g., frame f5 shows an officer’s arm extended toward the man’s head/face). The interaction is mutual and physical, escalating from confrontation to direct contact.

A chaotic group confrontation unfolds: multiple civilians (including individuals filming) are pressed against or clashing with a line of riot police; officers use batons and physical force while civilians resist or retreat; the scene shows collective violent unrest with multiple participants engaged in aggressive interactions beyond a single pair.
